thread:
alex: Overnight sweep results — found a pretty reproducible perf regression on H100 when KV prefetch is enabled together with the fused-paged FlashAttention variant. Quick summary: no-prefetch is faster for long seqs (>=1024) at small batch sizes.

jamie: Can you paste the numbers? cloud/regional skew? :eyes:

alex: Sure — ran H100/A100/L40s, seq sweep 512/1024/2048, batch sweep 1/2/4. The bad combo is H100 + fused-paged + kv-prefetch. Example (seq=2048, bsz=2):
```
# H100 seq=2048 bsz=2 (end-to-end decode tokens/sec, tail latencies)
variant              tok/s   p50    p99
no-prefetch          380     24ms   78ms
prefetch (paged+fuse)290     35ms   210ms
```
A100 shows a smaller delta (~5-10% slowdown), L40s actually improves slightly with prefetch.

sara: Interesting. So it's not universally bad. Might be an H100 hardware/kernels interaction. Any profile traces?

alex: Yeah attached a short perf dump and nvprof counters. Observations: prefetch increases concurrent memcpy + kernel launches, and on H100 we see more SM contention for the fused kernels. Flame snippet:
```
[flame] memcpy_async -> fused_attn_kern -> kv_cache_write
hotspot: fused_attn_kern (40% wall) vs 22% without prefetch
```
Also noted increased PCIe copy overlap leading to scheduling jitter for long seqs.

matt: Did you try disabling async memcpy overlap (i.e., serialize copies)? could be overlap triggering bad scheduling on H100 FW.

alex: I tried `KV_PREFETCH=off` and `KV_PREFETCH=async` variants. Serializing copies (no overlap) brings tok/s back in line but increases CPU wait. So it's a tradeoff.

anika: Any quick heuristic we can ship? Canary config?

jamie: Propose: add a runtime heuristic to disable KV prefetch when (device==H100 && seq_len>=1024 && batch_size<=2 && variant==fused-paged). Also add metric to detect >1.5x p99 regression and auto-fallback to no-prefetch.

sara: +1 to auto-fallback. We should also push a perf-test that runs the exact H100 seq/batch grid in CI (nightly) to catch regressions.

alex: I'll open a PR implementing the heuristic + a short repro test. Will include perf regression alert that triggers when the canary deviates.

ci-bot: build queued: perf-canary/h100-kv-prefetch-heuristic (job #452) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

matt: Thanks. If the PR lands, let's do an A/B canary on a small % of traffic for 24h then roll. We should also capture kernel occupancy and memcpy overlap metrics for the alert.

anika: Also note: this behaviour seems firmware-sensitive. If H100 microcode changes, upstream kernels might behave differently. Add FW version to the test matrix.

alex: Good call. I'll include GPU driver/fw + kernel hashes in the artefacts. Will post PR link and perf graphs here when ready. :thumbsup:
